Name: Challenging Vanilla Cornucopia WITHOUT FLOWERS Bundles
Author: Larvuk
AuthorLabel: Larvuk - adapted from CCCB VanillaCornucopia Bundle Pack by alvadea and jaksha
Description:
Challenging Community Center Bundles for players using [b]Cornucopia's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]More Crops[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Artisan Machines[/url] but [u]not[/u] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]More Flowers[/url].
Includes default and remixed bundles.

/!\ This mod uses the extended packs in Cornucopia options ([i][b]Extended Crop Pack[/b][/i], [i][b]Extended Tree Pack[/b][/i] & [i][b]Herbs Pack[/b][/i]).

If you're using Cornucopia - More Flowers, or different content mods (like SVE and RSV) you'll probably find a more suitable version for you on CCCB's mod page.


[b][u]Installation:[/u][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install Challenging Community Center Bundles [b][u]FIRST[/u][/b]. You'll find the version you need (the base version) [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6361?tab=files#file-expander-header-97464]here[/url]﻿[/b].
[*][u]After[/u] unzipping CCCB's Base Version in your mod folder, unzip this mod in the same folder.
[*]It will replace a file (config.json) with another version. That's what we want here.
[*]Check that you activated the extended packs in Cornucopia options ([i][b]Extended Crop Pack[/b][/i], [i][b]Extended Tree Pack[/b][/i] & [i][b]Herbs Pack[/b][/i]). You might need ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to do so.
[*]You're done!
[/list]

[u][b]If you like this mod and want to endorse it:[/b][/u]

It uses CCCB system and its content is based on CCCB Vanilla Conucopia Bundles by alvadea & jaksha. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6361]Consider endorsing it too[/url]﻿.

Have fun!
